name: Propynyl
summary: Propynyl, also known as 4-propynyloxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine or as propynylscaline, is a psychoactive drug of the scaline family related to mescaline. It is the derivative of mescaline in which the methoxy group at the 4 position has been replaced with a propynyloxy group.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of this kind can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, raised heart rate and blood pressure, and frightening experiences, and can trigger lasting mental health problems in vulnerable people.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類迷幻藥可能引起噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳和血壓上升以及驚恐的經驗，也可能在較脆弱的人身上誘發持久的精神健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类迷幻药可能引起恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳和血压上升以及惊恐的经验，也可能在较脆弱的人身上诱发持久的精神健康问题。

fact.en: Propynyl is mescaline with its middle methoxy group extended into a propynyloxy group, a short chain ending in a carbon to carbon triple bond.
fact.zh: Propynyl 是把麥司卡林中間的甲氧基延長成丙炔氧基，也就是末端帶有碳碳三鍵的短鏈。
fact.zhHans: Propynyl 是把麦司卡林中间的甲氧基延长成丙炔氧基，也就是末端带有碳碳三键的短链。
